summary.headline: Moon–Mars Quartile and Travel
summary.text: Book II, section 3, recounts Apomasar’s warning that a Moon–Mars quartile makes travel dangerous, illustrated by his advice to delay a journey from Rayy toward Baghdad because of robbers.
